newsitem.title: GERMANY: Protests cost Mercedes 200 million dmk - council.
newsitem.headline: Protests cost Mercedes 200 million dmk - council.

text.p: Daimler Benz AG's works council said on Tuesday that recent protests over wages at its Mercedes unit had so far cost the carmaker around 200 million marks in lost production.

Daimler Benz works council chairman Karl Feuerstein estimated that production of between four and five thousand passenger cars had been lost as a result of actions carried out by workers in the last week and on Tuesday.
Feuerstein could give no figure for the cost to the whole of the Daimler Benz group of worker protests on Tuesday.
Workers' representatives expected 100,000 workers to have taken part in protests by the end of Tuesday.
Workers are protesting over Daimler's plans to implement new legislation allowing companies to reduce payment for sick days to 80 percent of normal pay from 100 percent.
Daimler Benz was the first large German company to announce it would be implementing the sick pay cuts immediately.
